export default "---\r\nname: A1111\r\ndescription: Generate a compact five-line AI image prompt layout.\r\ninvokable: true\r\nalways: false\r\nversion: 1.0\r\nfeature_category: generation\r\n---\r\n# A1111 Bracketed\r\n\r\nProduce the image prompt in the compact five-line bracketed format below.
